fusions.name: Ribbon Whirl
fusions.desc: Whirls weighted ribbons around you, dealing 6 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, then you move 20% faster for 2 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Flashing Scarf
fusions.desc: Flicks a pale scarf that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 25% chance to leave it [Hindered] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Empty Coat
fusions.desc: Slips you out of your coat: for 2 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you, and you leap 3 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Skittish Fringe
fusions.desc: Every blow you avoid adds a fluttering ribbon on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per ribbon (18% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a ribbon fades every 6 seconds.
